# harvest/profile

A built-in enrich adapter for person records: it needs any of `linkedin_url` or `linkedin_internal_url` or `linkedin_sales_nav_url` and provides 10 fields. Plan estimates $0.0120 per record, and it demands `HARVEST_API_KEY`.

## Manifest

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| id | `harvest/profile` |
| version | 1 |
| role | enrich |
| entity type | person |
| credentials | `HARVEST_API_KEY` |
| cost estimate per record | $0.0120 |
| freshness | 30 days (the default `cache:` window) |

## Needs

```json
{
  "anyOf": [
    {
      "required": [
        "linkedin_url"
      ]
    },
    {
      "required": [
        "linkedin_internal_url"
      ]
    },
    {
      "required": [
        "linkedin_sales_nav_url"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "properties": {
    "linkedin_internal_url": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "linkedin_sales_nav_url": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "linkedin_url": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Provides

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "about": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "current_company": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "current_role": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "follower_count": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "headline": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "linkedin_url": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "location": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "open_to_work": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "recent_posts": {
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "type": "array"
    },
    "role_history": {
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Config keys

The keys `with:` accepts. Plan rejects any other key.

| Key | Type | Required | What it sets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | string |  | Override the API host (testing) |
| `cost_per_profile_usd` | number |  | What one lookup costs you, for the receipt |
| `main_only` | boolean |  | Ask for the cheaper main profile version |
| `posts_limit` | integer |  | Recent posts to fetch (0 skips the second call and its credits) |

## Example

From [Your stack](/start/my-stack):

```yaml
  - id: linkedin
    use: harvest/profile
    when: icp-filter.passed
    cache: 30d
    with:
      posts_limit: 3
```
